title: Fresh-User Synthetic Journey Evaluation Results
methodology: Five representative synthetic persona profiles (U-001 through U-005) were programmatically evaluated uncoached against the full Version 2 application stack and APIs under isolated tenant contexts. This confirms programmatic interaction, responsive rules, state persistence, zero data loss, and error handling. It does NOT constitute observed live human research; the deferred Phase 67 human participant obligation remains open until live consenting participants complete the session kit in artifacts/phase99/session-kit-and-checklist.md.

frictionObservationsAndResolutions.observation: At 320px ultra-compact width, secondary navigation buttons are hidden behind the overflow menu.
frictionObservationsAndResolutions.disposition: Intentional and correct responsive design via hide-below-380 CSS token; prevents horizontal page clipping while preserving all primary actions.

frictionObservationsAndResolutions.observation: Routine creation requires ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD activeFrom and IANA timezone fields.
frictionObservationsAndResolutions.disposition: Handled with default auto-population of user timezone (e.g. Asia/Dhaka) and today's date in client UI forms; API enforces strict validation.

frictionObservationsAndResolutions.observation: At 200% font scaling, modal dialog bodies require internal scrolling to reach lower fields.
frictionObservationsAndResolutions.disposition: Modal footers are pinned with position: sticky and bottom: 0, ensuring Save / Cancel buttons are never obscured or pushed out of view.
